description_md: Sequential primary key. The source has no sample identifier, and `(cruise_orig, line, station, order_occ)` is not unique — three station occupations were examined twice as replicate subsamples.
CalCOFI cruise natural key (`YYYY-MM-NODC`), derived by resolving the source label's two-letter ship abbreviation through `ship.ship_key`.
Two-letter CalCOFI ship abbreviation; FK to `ship`.
CalCOFI station key `'LLL.L SSS.S'`, formatted from `line` + `station`.
Collection date + time. Time zone is unconfirmed in the source and is carried through as given (see questions.csv).
Latitude of the matched CalCOFI station occupation. The source records no coordinates; see `position_source`.
Longitude of the matched CalCOFI station occupation. The source records no coordinates; see `position_source`.
How the coordinates were obtained: `swfsc_ichthyo:site` where the sample matched a CalCOFI station occupation on cruise + station + order of occupation, otherwise `unmatched` (position NULL).
The matched `sample.sample_key` (site grain) in the CalCOFI core model — the cross-dataset link back to the physical station occupation, its tows and its nets.
Point geometry of the matched station occupation (WGS84).
CalCOFI grid cell containing the sample position; FK to `grid`.
Person who examined the sample.
Sequential primary key.
The examined sample this count came from; FK to `dungeness_sample`.
Larval category counted; FK to `measurement_type`.
Count in the examined aliquot. NOT standardized — divide by `dungeness_sample.aliquot` for a whole-sample estimate.
Quality flag; `blank in source` where the source cell was empty, which distinguishes 'not recorded' from a recorded zero.
Sequential primary key.
The examined sample this individual came from; FK to `dungeness_sample`.
Ordinal of the measured individual within its sample, in source order. Not an identity — the source lists lengths without individual labels.
Sequential primary key. Rows repeat in the source (135 duplicate station-time combinations in the unsorted sheet), most likely one row per archived jar; see questions.csv.
`sorted` = examined for M. magister megalopae as of 2012-02-15; `unsorted` = archived but not yet examined.
`YYYY-MM` parsed from the expedition label where it embeds a YYMM code; NULL for the five named expeditions that do not (`ALCYONE 2`, `BODEGA BAY`, `CODE I LEG 3`, `SQ87`, `TROLL CRUISE`).
CalCOFI cruise key, assigned only where `cruise_ym` matches exactly one cruise in the reference — the source records no ship — and NULL otherwise.
CalCOFI station key formatted from `line` + `station`. Many lie outside the standard CalCOFI grid: this log extends north to Washington and far offshore.
Tow start date-time. Time zone unconfirmed; carried through as given.
Tow end date-time.
Point geometry of the tow position (WGS84).
CalCOFI grid cell; NULL for the majority, which lie north of or offshore from the CalCOFI grid.
Person who compiled the log and examined the sorted samples.
Sequential primary key, in source row order.
CalCOFI alongshore line, split from the source's combined 'line station' cell.
CalCOFI station key formatted from `line` + `station`.
Collection date + time of the plankton sample the specimen came from.
TRUE where independent review confirmed Metacarcinus magister.
